input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When the sick people first appear, add a visible sign of their illness, such as: “有的病人脸色发白，捂着肚子。”
2. At the point where Shennong suspects danger, add his worried thought: “神农想：这种植物会不会有毒？”
3. When the flowers are introduced, describe their appearance more vividly: “那些花是黄色的，像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete sign of illness that fits the scene and is simple Chinese.
The learner already says that Shennong thinks the plant may be poisonous.
It adds a simple visual description of the flowers without changing the story.
